items.text: Maz’ imyaka amajana ane na mirongumunani ishize, uhereye igihe Abisirayeli baviriye mu gihugu ca Egiputa, Salomo atangura kwubaka ingoro y’Uhoraho, hāri mu mwaka ugira kane ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa Zivu, ari kwo kwezi kwa kabiri.

Iyo ngoro umwami Salomo yubakiye Uhoraho, uburebure bgayo bgar’ amatambge mirongwitandatu y’ ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora, ubgaguke bgayo bgar’ amatambge mirongwibiri, uburebure bgayo bg’igihagararo bgar’ amatambge mirongwitatu.
Urubaraza ruherereye imbere y’Ahēra h’iyo ngoro, uburebure bgarwo bg’ amakika bgar’ amatambge mirongwibiri, nk’uk’ ubgaguke bg’iyo ngoro bgangana; ubgaguke bgarwo bgar’ amatambge cumi.
Iyo ngoro ayishiramw’ amadirisha y’ inshingo zikomeye.
Mu mbavu z’iyo ngoro ahōmeka utwumba tugerekeranye, dukikuje iyo ngoro yose uhereye Ahēra n’Ahēra Cane; uko ni ko yubatse utwumba tuyikikuje.

Utwumba two hasi, ubgaguke bgatwo bgar’ amatambge atanu; utwo hagati ubgaguke bgatwo bgar’ atandatu; utwa gatatu, ubgaguke bgatwo bgar’ indwi; ku gisika c’iyo ngoro ahahera inyuma, yagenda asiga ahaniguye impande zose, kugira ngw imbaho z’utwo twumba ntizinjire mu gisika c’iyo ngoro.
Mw iyubaka ry’iyo ngoro bayubakishije amabuye yatunganirijwe aho bayimvye; nta nyundo cank’ incabiti cank’ ikindi kintu cose c’icuma cumvikana mur’ iryo yubakwa ryayo.
Umuryango w’utwumba two hasi wari ku ruhande rw’i buryo rw’iyo ngoro; abāja mu twumba two hagati bāca ku curirizo cihotaguye mu gushikayo, bahavuye bagashika mu twa gatatu.
Uko ni ko yubatse iyo ngoro, arayuzuza; ayimanikisha ibishōro n’imbaho vy’amasederi.

Twa twumba yometse kur’ iyo ngoro impande zose, kamwe‐kamwe uburebure bgako bg’igihagararo bgar’ amatambge atanu y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora; twari twubatswe ku myaro y’amasederi ifashe kur’ iyo ngoro.
Bukeye ijambo ry’Uhoraho riza kuri Salomo,

riti Ku vy’ iyi ngoro urik’ urubaka, ni wagendera mu vyo nashinze, ugashitsa amabgirizwa yanje, ukitondera ivyagezwe vyanje vyose, ukaba ari vyo ugenderamwo, nanje nzokomeza ijambo ryanje kuri wewe, iryo navuganye na so Dawidi.
Kandi nzoba mu Bisirayeli, sinzoheba abantu banje.
Uko ni ko Salomo yubatse iyo ngoro, arayuzuza.
Imbere ku bisika vy’iyo ngoro ahōmeka imbaho z’amasederi; uhereye hasi ugashitsa ku myaro y’urusenge, imbere hose ahōmeka imbaho; kandi hasi ahasasa imbaho z’akajwari.

Haruguru imbere mur’ iyo ngoro ahōmeka imbaho z’ amasederi kumara amatambge mirongwibiri, uhereye hasi ugashitsa ku myaro; aho hantu imbere haruguru arahakīngīra kugira ngo habe ahantu hiherereye, habe Ahēra Cane.
Ingoro isigaye hino y’Ahēra Cane yar’ amatambge mirongwine; ni yo yitwa Ahēra.
Hose imbere mur’ iyo ngoro hāri hōmetse imbaho z’ amasederi zisharijwekw ibishushanyo vy’uturende n’amashurwe asambuye; hose zar’ imbaho z’ amasederi, nta buye ryaboneka.
Nukw atunganya Ahēra Cane aho nyene imbere haruguru mur’ iyo ngoro, kugira ngw ahatereke isandugu y’isezerano ry’Uhoraho.

Kand’ Ahēra Cane, amakika yaho yar’ amatambge mirongwibiri, n’ubgaguke bgaho bgari mirongwibiri, n’uburebure bg’igihagararo na bgo bgari mirongwibiri nyene. Hose ahōmekakw izahabu iramuye, abāza n’igicaniro mw isederi, na co acomekakw izahabu, agitereka imbere y’Ahēra Cane.
Nuko ku ngoro imbere hose ahōmekakw izahabu iramuye, araheza atambika iminyororo y’izahabu imbere y’Ahēra Cane.
Nuko ku ngoro hose yahōmetse izahabu kugeza ingoro yose ihwanye; na ca gicaniro c’imbere y’ Ahēra Cane na co yacometsekw izahabu hose.
Abāza mu biti vy’imyelayo ibishushanyo vy’abakerubi bibiri vyo gushira Ahēra Cane, uburebure bgavyo bgar’ amatambge cumi y’ukuboko uciriye mu nkokora.
Uburebure bg’ibaba rimwe ry’umukerubi bgar’ amatambge atanu, n’irindi baba n’uko: uhereye kw isonga ry’ibaba rimwe ukageza ku ry’irindi yar’ amatambge cumi.
Igishushanyo c’ umukerubi ca kabiri uburebure bgaco bgar’ amatambge cumi nyene; abo bakerubi bompi bārangana cabugerwe, kandi n’ishusho yabo yar’ imwe.
Uburebure bg’umukerubi umwe bgar’ amatambge cumi, n’ubg’ uwundi kuno nyene.

Nukw atereka abo bakerubi aho nyene haruguru mur’ iyo ngoro; amababa yabo yar’ ashānje, ibaba ry’umwe ryaruma ku nzu ku ruhande rumwe, iry’ uwundi ku rundi ruhande, yandi abiri agasomanira hagati mu nzu.
Ku nzu hose imbere mur’ iyo ngoro ahabāzira ibishushanyo vy’ abakerubi n’ivy’ ibigazi n’ivy’ amashurwe asambuye, imbere haruguru no hino.
No hasi mur’ iyo ngoro ahōmeka izahabu, imbere haruguru no hino.
Umuryango uja Ahēra Cane awushirakw inzugi z’imbaho z’ imyelayo; uwo muryango, hakora ikibambāsi co hejuru n’ibishimaryango, watwaye umwanya w’ikigiragatanu c’umukingo waho.

Kand’ abāza inzugi zibiri mu mbaho z’imyelayo, mu kuzibāza azishushanyakw ibishushanyo vy’ abakerubi n’ivy’ ibigazi n’ivy’ amashurwe asambuye, azomekakw izahabu, ayiyagiriza no kur’ ivyo bishushanyo vy’abakerubi no ku vy’ibigazi.
Akora ibishimaryango vy’ urwinjiriro rw’urusengero mu biti vy’imyelayo, uwo muryango utwara umwanya w’ikigirakane c’urwo ruhande;
akora n’inzugi zaho zibiri mu mbaho z’akajwari; urugi rumwe iyo buguruye, imbaho zarwo zompi zarīzinga, n’iz’ urwa kabiri zīzinga kuno nyene.
Kandi mu kuzibāza azishushanyakw ibishushanyo vy’abakerubi n’ivy’ ibigazi n’ivy’ amashurwe asambuye, azomekakw izahabu ayikuyengeza no kur’ ivyo bishushanyo.
Urugo rw’inyubakwa arwubakisha amabuye abājwe imirongo itatu igerekeranye, n’uwundi murongo w’ibiti bibājwe vy’amasederi.
Igihe bātanguriye kwubaka itanguriro ry’iyo ngoro y’Uhoraho hāri mu mwaka ugira kane Salomo ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa Zivu.
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na rimwe, mu kwezi kwa Bulu, ari kwo kwezi kw’umunani, barangiza iyo ngoro n’ivyayo vyose, nk’ukw icitegererezo cayo cose cari kimeze. Nuko yamaze imyaka ndwi ayubaka.
